description:
List authors linked to one claim.

    Use this when you have a claim id and need the people linked to it.
    Returns author id, name, and orcid. The list is empty when none are linked.
    Example: get_authors(claim_id="claim-attention").
    Example: get_authors(claim_id="<id from query_claims>").

claim_id.description: Claim id returned by a search tool. Example: claim-attention.
claim_id.title: Claim Id

name: get_authors

AuthorNode.description: One author. No profile fields beyond id, display name, and ORCID.
AuthorNode.title: AuthorNode

outputSchema.description: Authors linked to one claim. The list is empty when none are stored.
outputSchema.title: AuthorsResult
